But maybe the notice board is a wall-mounted object and the body is actually fine, and the "blocks" is just describing the object. The movement failing might be a different issue.

Let me try moving the PLAYER instead — no, I control the body. 

Let me try a fresh walk to a nearby tile with the adjacent mode, and check if maybe the issue is the player blocking me. The player is at (3,7) — directly to my right. Maybe the player is blocking my rightward movement! Let me try moving left, up, down which don't have the player.
